briefs.title: agent-1
briefs.problem: Teams lose hours triaging the same production alerts by hand every week.
briefs.user: On-call engineers at small software teams
briefs.mechanism: An agent watches a stream of events and files structured tickets with a suggested owner.
briefs.why_now: The README shows 1,000 stars in its first week and a launch post on the front page.

briefs.title: Show HN: A to-do list – plans your week
briefs.problem: People write to-do lists but never turn them into a realistic plan for the week.
briefs.user: Knowledge workers who plan their own week
briefs.mechanism: A planner takes an unordered list of tasks with rough sizes and packs them into calendar slots.
briefs.why_now: The Show HN post reached 100 points in two days with comments asking for team support.

briefs.title: Level Designer
briefs.problem: Blocking out a first playable level takes a designer most of a day.
briefs.mechanism: A model turns a short text description into a tile grid that an engine can import.
briefs.why_now: The space is trending with 100 likes this week after a model release.
